orc.lore: Orcs were once the rulers of their world, but after the REALM LORD took them in they found a new home here

elf.lore: Elves are in tune with nature and close to magic, they rule the mystical parts of REALM under the LORD

human.lore: Humans wandered into the REALM accidentally all thanks to curiosity, they are now devoted to the REALM LORD

fiend.lore: Fiends invaded the REALM, most of them are still hostile but a few have made a deal with the REALM LORD

cyborg.lore: Cyborgs are the technically advanced humans, they were made in the REALM by the LORD to upkeep peace in times of need
